input.context: The crew plugin needs a parallel-dispatch mechanism that fans out N builder subagents across N git worktrees simultaneously. Each worktree needs isolation for file state and workflow-state but must share the same git remote. The orchestrator must wait for all builders to finish and aggregate results, halting on any FAIL verdict. Windows support required.
constraints: Must work on Windows — no symbolic link support by default
Node 22.6+ strip-types runtime for orchestrator scripts
Bun 1.3+ for test runner only — not consumer runtime (ADR-002)
No shared mutable state between worktrees
Orchestrator delegates only — no direct implementation

expected_output.summary: Use git worktree add per slice; orchestrator spawns builders as independent Claude Code subagents each with own .claude/state/; aggregate via structured JSON stdout; halt-on-FAIL in aggregator
expected_output.non_goals_explicit: Does not build Docker-per-agent isolation (30s startup overhead); does not address cross-repo parallelism
failure_modes_named: git worktree add fails on Windows with long paths (260-char MAX_PATH)
worktree left on-disk after SIGTERM — needs cleanup hook
state file race on git merge when worktrees finish concurrently

dependencies_graphed.git_worktree: child_process.spawnSync git worktree add; each worktree is own working tree under .claude/worktrees/<id>/
dependencies_graphed.fleet_visibility: crew fleet --repo reads .git/worktrees/ directory for active trees

interfaces_typed.WorktreeDispatchResult: { worktree: string; agent: string; verdict: 'PASS'|'FAIL'|'SKIP'; artifact_path: string | null }

expected_output.test_strategy_present: Integration: spin 2 worktrees, inject FAIL on one, assert aggregator halts and cleans both up
expected_output.tradeoffs_articulated: git worktree shares .git/refs — concurrent tag pushes race; mitigated by never tagging inside dispatch loop. Docker alternative rejected: 30s startup per agent multiplies linearly; no measured win on correctness.

notes: Mined from FEAT-136 / DEC-015 — parallel-runner vs crew:build-per-worktree. Path A (per-worktree crew:build) shipped. Seed type: greenfield_design.
